item.title: RecScale: System-Aware Scaling Laws for Deep Learning Recommendation Models
item.description: This blog presents the motivation, design principles, and key results behind RecScale, a system-aware approach to scaling Deep Learning Recommendation Models (DLRMs) that addresses critical memory and communication bottlenecks in distributed training.
